gloss: Japanese food restaurant; Japanese cuisine restaurant

definitions.gloss: Japanese food restaurant; Japanese cuisine restaurant
definitions.explanation: A restaurant specializing in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: {近|ちか}くに{和食屋|わしょくや}はありますか。
examples.english: Is there a Japanese restaurant nearby?

examples.japanese: あの{和食屋|わしょくや}は{予約|よやく}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: That Japanese restaurant requires a reservation.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しい{和食屋|わしょくや}が{開店|かいてん}した。
examples.english: A new Japanese restaurant opened in front of the station.

notes:
A compound of {和食|わしょく} (Japanese food/cuisine) and {屋|や} (shop/restaurant). The {屋|や} suffix is productive and forms names for various types of shops and restaurants. {和食屋|わしょくや} is used when the speaker wants to specify Japanese cuisine as opposed to other types.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {和食屋|わしょくや}で{食|た}べる: to eat at a Japanese restaurant
- {和食屋|わしょくや}を{探|さが}す: to look for a Japanese restaurant
- {高級|こうきゅう}{和食屋|わしょくや}: upscale Japanese restaurant

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {和食|わしょく}レストラン: Japanese restaurant — more formal, uses the loanword
- {日本料理店|にほんりょうりてん}: Japanese cuisine restaurant — more formal and specific
- {割烹|かっぽう}: traditional Japanese restaurant — implies a more refined, chef-driven dining experience
- {料亭|りょうてい}: high-class Japanese restaurant — exclusive establishments with private rooms
